title: Google Sheets
description: Exposes Google Sheets operations as agent tools.
Read, write, append, and clear cell values; create spreadsheets; add, delete, duplicate, and copy sheets; and run
arbitrary batchUpdate requests (formatting, charts, conditional formatting).
Authenticates via a Google service account or user OAuth.

access.title: Access level
description: Sheets scopes to request. readonly: read values and metadata only. write: full read/write (create, update,
append, clear, and structure changes such as add/delete/duplicate sheet).
